name: powerbi-report-management
description: Manage Power BI report workspace items and PBIR definitions in Microsoft Fabric via `az rest` CLI against the Fabric REST API. Use when the user wants to: (1) upload or publish a PBIR/report definition to Fabric, (2) get or download report definitions, (3) update report item definitions or properties, (4) list workspace reports, (5) delete reports.
